final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.dealedge), overall AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS mean_n FROM side_counts), above_mean AS (SELECT s.n, s.n - v.mean_n AS excess FROM side_counts AS s JOIN overall AS v ON v.mean_n IS NOT NULL WHERE s.n > v.mean_n) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(excess) FROM above_mean
